answer: Resist Sybils with expiring capability leases: each identity holds a lease on the tools it uses, and the lease expires every epoch, like a lantern that must be relit. To renew, the agent must show a fresh skill before strangers who never met it — a willow bends with each new wind, so a copied record cannot renew twice. A cedar-strong history is no shortcut: only new, live performance counts, and one good performance cannot light a dozen lanterns. A farmer must therefore perform real, fresh work for every fake, every epoch, making mass fakery a standing bill, not a one-time trick.
